MyHealth reads your workouts, steps, distance, speed, cadence, cycling power, cycling cadence, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, calories, floors, elevation, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, VO2 max, sleep, weight and body fat from Health Connect. It never writes anything back.
This data is used to show your training history, to estimate training load and recovery, and to work out daily calorie and macro targets that match what you actually did.
Your data stays on this device. MyHealth stores everything in a local database, has no account, and does not upload your health data to any server.
You can withdraw access at any time in the Health Connect app. MyHealth then keeps only the data already synced, which you can delete from the app.
